page_title: AilaFlow | Self-Hosted AI Workspace for Teams

summary.name: AilaFlow
summary.one_liner: AilaFlow is a self-hosted AI workspace where teams build workflows that connect tools and data, with access controls and human approval steps, used through AI chat and forms.
use_cases: production change approval before scripts run
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI workspace where an administrator builds workflows using AI or a visual builder, connecting tools, data, and everyday tasks. Administrators choose which people or groups can access each workflow, which actions AI can perform, and which steps require human approval. Team members start workflows, complete tasks, and approve decisions through AI chat and simple forms. The page says people and AI work on the same underlying workflows and process state. Example workflows include purchase requests, HR/IT onboarding, invoice processing, production change approval, alert response, and customer information intake.
notable: Self-hosted, installed via Docker and an npm CLI (ailaflow serve), then set up at localhost:2048/install
Per-workflow access control and configurable AI action permissions
Human approval points set at any workflow step
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
